liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Good Lovin'** (1 review, 1 other source): Bob delivered a very strange rap, which the reviewer links to the Chernobyl accident; Includes a rap about a radioactive cloud during Good Lovin' [4][16]
- **One More Saturday Night** (1 review): Opened the show with the number that would have been the previous night's encore, which was dropped because of sound trouble [13]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China Cat > Rider pairing closes the first set, which the reviewer enjoys [22]
- **Gimme Some Lovin'** (1 review): Brent's organ was prominent and energetic, with growling vocals from Phil and Jerry near the end [23]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer finds Space evocative: shimmering water and a lone ancient ruin column under moonlight, which captures what the band means to them [14]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Named among the high points of the show, alongside Playin' and Miracle [20]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Highlight is the Playin' > Drums > Space > Uncle John's Band > Playin' sequence [17]
- **Box Of Rain** (1 review): The Box Of Rain encore was a personal highlight for the reviewer [17]

## Setlist highlights

- **equipment breaks again**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [25]
- **encore.Box Of Rain**: rare: 4 archived performances [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-05-04.156458.akgc422.davis.holbrook.flac2448** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 128 min [1]. Said about its sound: Heavy bass distortion at the start of Saturday Night, with random Phil distortion until the sound settled; Splice is whooshy for about three seconds, followed by a clear change in sound quality [1]
- **gd1986-05-04.sbd.miller.81603.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 129 min; rated 3/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sound quality is pretty good [22]
- **gd1986-05-04.Senn421sNak300CP4s.Darby.119545.Flac2448**: audience recording; 19 songs; 125 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd86-05-04.schoeps.eD.15234.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 130 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is somewhat quiet in volume but overall decent for an audience tape; Audience recording sounds good, improved by a slight low-end EQ adjustment [18][20]
- **gd1986-05-04.148869.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 129 min [6]

## Around the show

- Rain fell at the start; from the lawn, about ten feet from Jerry, the reviewer saw him grin skyward during the weather lyric [17]
- Jerry broke two guitar strings during the show, and Phil said afterward that his mind was blown [21]
- Reviewer attended and made a first taping attempt that went mostly badly [23]
- 1986 was uneven for the band, but the reviewer rates this show as pretty good by comparison [18]
- Few 1986 audience tapes are keepers for this reviewer, but this one is, thanks to a consistent, solid performance [20]
- Reviewer calls this the best-ever Gimme Some Lovin' [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-05-04.156458.akgc422.davis.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew; Kenny Davis; Mike Davis; Tom Pinney; John Goode; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Source: 1GEN AUDCA speed corrected 1.5% Microphones: AKG c422 cardioid (X-Y at 90') chest level|AKG B18 Recorder: Sony TC-D5M| Maxell MX 90's no Dolby (1st in… [1]. Also: Master tape was flipped at China > Rider, so the suite was spliced onto side two during first-generation copying in 1986 [1]
- **gd1986-05-04.sbd.miller.81603.flac16**: taped by Thanks to Paul Scotton and Joani Walker for the Cassettes; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MA-R90) D [3]. Also: Source chain is Schoeps CMC4/MK41 microphones to PCM, then DAT, then CD; This source supplies a patch in Space, from 0:54 to 1:01 [3]
- **gd1986-05-04.Senn421sNak300CP4s.Darby.119545.Flac2448**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; Sennheiser MD421's + Nakamichi CM300/CP4s> (PAS/DFC/2nd Row Of OTS/6 Feet High)> Sony MX 10>Sony TC-D5M,Tape Maxell MX;… [4]. Also: Recorded by Darby as a four-microphone mix, shared in the Darby collection [4]
- **gd86-05-04.schoeps.eD.15234.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>PCM>DAT>CDR [5]
- **gd1986-05-04.148869.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master Audience Cassettes; Neumann KM84i mics > Sony D5M [6]
